summary: CheckCle là nền tảng giám sát self-hosted cho hệ thống full-stack, cung cấp giám sát uptime theo thời gian thực, kiểm tra phân tán và tracking sự cố.
usecases: Monitoring uptime and health of microservices in Kubernetes environments
Tracking application performance and availability across dev and prod stages
Incident tracking and alerting for self-hosted infrastructure
ideas: Integrate with incident management platforms like PagerDuty for automated response
Develop custom dashboards for specific open-source projects
Serve as a monitoring foundation for air-gapped or offline environments
